EBONYI (PSI 9.6): Attorney General Dr. Ben Odoh and Chief Judge Elvis Ngene launched the NCMS e-Filing Platform in Abakaliki to eliminate physical court registry delays and automate litigation workflows.
KATSINA (PSI 9.5): Governor Dikko Radda led Northwest Governors in New York to unveil the 2026–2030 regional security and development framework alongside UN Deputy Secretary-General Amina Mohammed.

FCT ABUJA (PSI 9.4): FCT Minister Nyesom Wike inspected Wuye N1 road, Tunga Madaki-Zuba road, and 5.6km Zaudna-Kabba-Kagini rural road, guaranteeing December completion while refuting illegal loan claims.

ONDO (PSI 9.3): Governor Lucky Aiyedatiwa approved full CONUASS wage structure for state universities, flagged off ₦400m bursaries for 13,360 students, released ₦633.9m WASSCE fees, and appointed Micro Credit Chair.
ZAMFARA (PSI 9.2): Health Commissioner Dr. Nafisa Maradun announced Governor Dauda Lawal's approval of a 95% CONHESS wage increase for state health workers to curb brain drain and absenteeism.

DELTA (PSI 9.1): Governor Sheriff Oborevwori inaugurated Governing Councils for 3 state universities, swore in Auditor-General Matthew Oghene, and approved two 480-bed hostels per tertiary institution.
IMO (PSI 9.0): Governor Hope Uzodimma addressed CARSPO 2026 in Owerri, calling for police professionalism, intelligence-led technology, and political neutrality ahead of the 2027 elections.

KEBBI (PSI 8.9): Governor Nasir Idris joined UNGA 81 investment briefings in New York while the Environment Ministry flagged off World Bank ACRESAL erosion/flood control works in Birnin Kebbi for 50,000 residents.
KADUNA (PSI 8.9): Governor Uba Sani approved ₦3.659 billion for 1,339 public service retirees (reaching ₦21.455bn total in 3 years), while KIVTSD opened tuition-free admissions across 14 trade areas.
RIVERS (PSI 8.8): Governor Siminalayi Fubara showcased Rivers State's hydrocarbon and blue economy investment opportunities to international financiers at UNGA 81 side events in New York.

ABIA (PSI 8.8): Announced October mosquito net distribution and civil service absorption for 88 TechRise graduates, while Governor Alex Otti delivered a keynote at the 'Ohaneze at 50' book presentation.

NASARAWA (PSI 8.7): Governor Abdullahi Sule promoted Nasarawa's solid mineral potential at UNGA 81 investment briefings and attended the Dangote Petroleum Refinery IPO International Roadshow in New York.

LAGOS (PSI 8.7): Environment Commissioner Tokunbo Wahab ordered immediate evacuation for low-lying coastal communities following a 7-day flood alert, while Gov. Sanwo-Olu celebrated King Sunny Ade's 80th birthday.

CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.6): Governor's Wife Bishop Eyoanwan-Itam Bassey Otu concluded her 11th medical outreach in Yala with 167 free surgeries, while Obudu Council Leader Hon. Eneji Ashibi empowered 149 constituents.

EDO (PSI 8.5): Civil Service Commission started CBT examinations for 521 shortlisted applicants in Benin City, while Livestock Commissioner Hon. Ohimai Ehijimetor met national L-PRES leadership in Abuja.
NIGER (PSI 8.4): Governor Umaru Bago received traditional, CAN, and university delegations over 37 deceased miners, while paying ₦300m out of ₦800m ASUU arrears to resolve the IBBU Lapai strike.

PLATEAU (PSI 8.3): Governor Caleb Mutfwang received former Archbishop of Canterbury Justin Welby on peacebuilding, while Commerce Commissioner Musa Ashoms revealed Plateau's rise to 6th in Ease of Doing Business.
YOBE (PSI 8.2): Governor Mai Mala Buni hosted Russian firm Legion Investment Moscow to inspect technical sites for gas-powered electricity generation plants in the state Agro-Industrial Zone.

BAYELSA (PSI 8.1): Deputy Governor Dr. Peter Akpe mediated between Akenfa community leaders, NDDC, and Renaissance Energy, urging residents to unblock oil facilities while promising bridge completion.
KOGI (PSI 8.0): Deputy Governor Joel Salifu Oyibo led the state Burial Committee to meet the family of late former Governor Alhaji Ibrahim Idris, confirming full state sponsorship for his funeral.
GOMBE (PSI 7.9): Governor Muhammadu Inuwa Yahaya approved the appointment of Usman Mohammed Shanu as Secretary of the House of Assembly Service Commission to ensure administrative continuity.
OYO (PSI 7.8): Governor Seyi Makinde clarified at a town hall meeting in Katsina that the Ibadan Airport upgrade is 100% state-funded, refuting claims of a ₦50 billion federal grant.
ADAMAWA (PSI 7.7): Christian Pilgrims Welfare Board ES Chief Geoffrey Garba announced NCPC-approved screening dates (Sept 28–30) for 664 intending pilgrims in daily batches of 220.

ENUGU (PSI 7.6): Governor Peter Mbah approved the appointment of 22 senior political aides covering conflict resolution, economic development, creative industry, fiscal reform, and forest conservation.
OSUN (PSI 7.5): Governor Ademola Adeleke issued a state tribute commiserating with the Lawal family and Ede community over the passing of business leader and Babalaje of Edeland, Alhaji Raheem Lawal.
